title: Comunicado 2025-11-06
summary: Banxico cut the policy rate 25bp to 7.25% by a 4-1 majority, with Heath again dissenting for a hold at 7.50%, and still judged it appropriate to 'continuar con el ciclo de disminuciones', citing the peso, weak activity (Q3 now an outright contraction) and trade-policy risks, while noting the degree of restriction already implemented. The key change versus the September communique is the forward guidance: the open-ended plural 'valorará recortes adicionales' becomes the singular 'valorará recortar la tasa de referencia', a more cautious, less pre-committed signal that the cycle is slowing rather than a commitment to a series of further cuts. The inflation counterweight is unchanged: headline eased to 3.63% but core is stuck at 4.24%, longer-term expectations remain above target and the risk balance is still tilted up, though less than in 2021-2024. Net, the same 25bp cut and split as September but with softer easing guidance, so the read moves from cut-with-more-cuts-as-base-case to cut with a more cautious path, trimmed by Heath's dissent.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó apropiado continuar con el ciclo de disminuciones de la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: The Board still frames the decision as a continuation of the easing cycle

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortar la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Guidance softened from September's 'valorará recortes adicionales' to a singular, less committed 'recortar'

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza, si bien este es menos pronunciado que el enfrentado entre 2021 y 2024.
key_quotes.context: Upside tilt to the inflation risk balance remains the main brake

key_quotes.quote: Votó a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 7.50% Jonathan Heath.
key_quotes.context: Heath's dissent for a hold persists
